The tests for #40841 were passed but when I merged master into it I got the error
[landrun:error] 2026/08/04 06:34:25 Failed to apply sandbox: failed to apply Landlock restrictions: missing kernel Landlock support. Got Landlock ABI v5, wanted {Landlock V9; FS: all; Net: ∅; Scoped: all}
and the warning
Runner Version 2.334.0 will no longer be able to run jobs on August 10, 2026, please update your runner version..

When normally a build fails due to runner reasons merging master fixes it. However, I just did that. Is this issue known? If so, can I do something about it or should I wait until an admin updates the runners?
also happens in #42427 and #42428 (and presumably all newly opened prs...)

This is also affecting merging PRs into master.
@Bryan Gin-ge Chen @𝚠𝚘𝚓𝚌𝚒𝚎𝚌𝚑 𝚗𝚊𝚠𝚛𝚘𝚌𝚔𝚒 @Kim Morrison Who can best diagnose/fix this?

OK, I think this is fixed now :fingers_crossed: . The issue was indeed a breaking change in landrun; I've pinned the version we're using and will discuss with Marcelo Lynch how best to upgrade the runners when he's back.
#41136, #42431, #42432 need to be kicked back on the bors queue
I disagree about the first one (#42270 should land first, so it's blocked on that), but borsed the other two.
#42432 failed again :frown:
